treatment: Complete clearcut, 1962–1966; skyline yarding without roads. Broadcast burned October 1966; seeded 1967–1968 and planted 1969/1971.
disturbance: Holiday Farm Fire, 2020: whole watershed burned, mainly low to moderate severity.
notes: The web summary says burned 1967; the detailed history says October 1966. The detailed history also has a short 1963–1965 entry; its full narrative gives 1962–1966.
name: Watershed 1

treatment: Unharvested experimental reference for WS1 and WS3.
disturbance: Holiday Farm Fire, 2020: upper watershed burned at low to moderate severity; current web summary gives approximately 50% burned.
notes: Reference denotes the assigned harvest treatment. The detailed history separately reports a GIS harvest estimate of 2.1%; do not substitute this for treatment assignment.
name: Watershed 2

treatment: Roads built in 1959 (6% of area); 25% patch clearcut in winter 1962–1963; slash burned September 1963; planted 1964.
disturbance: Debris flows in December 1964 and February 1996 destroyed the gauge. Recent wildfire extent is not quantified here.
notes: Gauge elevation is 471 m in the detailed history and 476 m in the web table. Interrupted or estimated discharge periods follow the debris flows.
name: Watershed 3

treatment: Complete clearcut in 1974; roaded area reported as 9%. Broadcast burned spring 1975; planted 1976.
disturbance: Recent wildfire extent is not quantified in the sources used for this summary.
notes: Historical low-flow leakage is documented; review instrument and rating history before analyzing discharge.
name: Watershed 6

treatment: Shelterwood cut in 1974 removed about 60% of basal area. Burned below the road in 1975; planted 1976. Remaining overstory removed 1984; young stand thinned in 2001.
disturbance: Recent wildfire extent is not quantified in the sources used for this summary.
notes: 60% refers to basal area removed, not 60% of catchment area clearcut. The web table calls the 2001 event a 12% noncommercial thin; the detailed narrative describes thinning to about 220 trees/acre.
name: Watershed 7

treatment: Unharvested experimental reference for WS6 and WS7.
disturbance: Recent wildfire extent is not quantified in the sources used for this summary.
notes: The reference designation does not establish absence of later disturbance.
name: Watershed 8

treatment: Unharvested experimental reference for WS10; drains directly toward Blue River Reservoir, outside Lookout Creek.
disturbance: Holiday Farm Fire, 2020: watershed burned at mixed severity.
notes: Use 8.5 ha from the HF004 detailed gauge history. Some older catalog prose gives 21.2 ha; that conflicts with the gauge history and current infrastructure table.
name: Watershed 9

treatment: Complete clearcut in 1975 with skyline yarding. Slash removed to a landing; no burning within the watershed. Planted in 1976.
disturbance: A February 1986 debris flow destroyed the gauge. Recent wildfire extent is not quantified here.
notes: Use 10.2 ha from the HF004 detailed gauge history. Some older catalog prose gives 25.3 ha. Individual papers may use a different comparison basin; check each analysis.
name: Watershed 10

treatment: Predominantly old growth; 12.9% harvested in 1962 in upper-basin clearcut/salvage units near the ridge road.
disturbance: Lookout Fire, 2023: whole watershed burned at mixed severity.
notes: Not a wholly unharvested control. Detailed gauge history gives 581 ha; infrastructure table rounds to 580 ha. Navigation elsewhere labels 1,436 ha; that is inconsistent with this gauged-basin definition.
name: Mack Creek

treatment: Landscape basin with approximately 25% harvested and an extensive road network; web table lists harvest 1952–1985 and roads on 10% of area.
disturbance: Holiday Farm (2020) and Lookout (2023) fires together affected about 70% of the basin, at mixed severity.
notes: USGS 14161500. Harvest dates vary among summaries (1950–1990 in the detailed treatment entry). This is a nested landscape integrator, not an independent treatment replicate.
name: Lookout Creek
